intro: Ukor's Lost Pack is a dropped item found in the wilds of southern Durotar, bearing the crudely stitched name of its owner. It was discarded in haste when Ukor fled from a terrifying encounter with a huge spider native to the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
